paper.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
paper.authors: Yao, Yu, Zhao, Shafran, Griffiths, Cao, Narasimhan
paper.summary: 本文提出 Tree of Thoughts (ToT)，把语言模型推理建模为对中间思维树的搜索：每一步生成多个候选思维并用模型自评估优劣，再用 BFS/DFS 进行探索与回溯。创新之处在于把链式 CoT 的单路径生成升级为可分支、可前瞻、可回溯的深思熟虑推理。在 Game of 24 上 ToT (b=5) 达成 74% 成功率，相较 CoT 的 4% 显著提升，同时在 Creative Writing 与 Mini Crosswords 上也优于 IO/CoT 基线。

figure1.description: Game of 24 — Success rate vs nodes visited per task. IO/CoT use best-of-k (k=1..100); ToT uses b=1..5 (5 points).
figure1.source: Pixel calibration on Figure 3a. Endpoints anchored: IO best-of-100=33%, CoT best-of-100=49%, ToT b=1=45%, ToT b=5=74% (paper Table 2).

figure2.description: Game of 24 — Fraction of samples that failed at each step (1/2/3/4) vs reached Correct, comparing CoT and ToT (b=5).
figure2.source: Pixel calibration on Figure 3b. Anchors: ToT (b=5) Correct=0.74 (paper Table 2 = 74%); CoT step-1 fail ≈ 0.60 (paper text: 'around 60% of CoT samples already failed the task after generating the first step').

figure3.description: Creative Writing — Human pairwise coherency comparison (out of 100 pairs). CoT > ToT: 21, Similar: 38, ToT > CoT: 41.
figure3.source: Direct readout from Figure 5b — labels printed on bars: 21 / 38 / 41.
